task.description: Write regression tests for GH-512 / ISS-0181 T010 hardcoded-UUID migration. Three tests: TC-RG-01 (T010 BLOCKER ceiling), TC-RG-02 (baseline shape), TC-RG-03 (zig build test exit 0). Subprocess-driven, no BPM_TEST_DB_URL required.
acceptance_criteria: All 3 regression tests pass (TC-RG-01, TC-RG-02, TC-RG-03)
No mocks, no SkipZigTest, no BPM_TEST_DB_URL dependency
Per-test UUIDs used wherever a fixture ID is created

result.summary: 3 regression tests added at tests/integration/gh512_t010_regression_test.zig, all pass. Build target `test-integration-gh512` added to build.zig and wired through main_test.zig. Test spec at tests/specs/ISS-0181-gh512-t010-retire.md; baseline snapshot at tests/specs/fixtures/gh512-baseline-snapshot.json. Subprocess-driven (linter + zig build), so BPM_TEST_DB_URL not required. After back-end-dev's std.fs.cwd() -> std.Io.Dir.cwd().readFileAlloc() correction (Zig 0.16 fs API), compile is clean and all three tests pass: TC-RG-01 reports T010 count = 74 against ceiling 74, TC-RG-02 confirms baseline shape, TC-RG-03 confirms zig build test exits 0.

issues.description: Original subagent draft used std.fs.cwd().readFileAlloc() and a pointless _ = argv_buf discard + wrong argv slice type. Backend-dev (me) corrected to std.Io.Dir.cwd().readFileAlloc(io, path, alloc, std.Io.Limit.limited(N)) and rebuilt argv as a clean []const []const u8. No functional impact on the migration; just compile-fix pass.
